item.tib: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi che ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i nang nas mtsham 'bum gra ba rtse lnga'i gzungs
item.note: a similar collection of tog gi gzungs (for the finial of the mchod rten) exists in chos tradition. orally transmitted by mkha'-'gro 'od-ldan 'bar-ma to gling-gshen blo-gros rgyal-mtshan. zhu-g.yas ku-su-so-ba (spelled ku-su-lo-ba earlier on) collected it at skyid-mkhar gsang-ba'i brag-phug.
